name: Smith River (Permit)
gaugeName: Smith bl Eagle Creek nr Fort Logan
blurb: Montana's only permit-lottery river. 59 canyon miles, 4–5 days, zero cell service.

sections.notes: Launch requires an FWP permit. Below ~150 cfs expect to drag boats.

distanceEvidence.sourceName: Montana FWP Smith River Recreation Management Plan (2026), p. 19
distanceEvidence.note: The 2026 FWP management plan identifies Camp Baker at mile 0 and Eden Bridge at mile 58.8. This is the permitted trip length, not a measurement from the approximate map markers.

putInAccess.sourceName: Montana FWP Smith River Recreation Management Plan (2026), p. 19
putInAccess.note: The 2026 management plan confirms this public boat access. FWP State Parks GIS geometry supplies a facility location; exact ramp coordinates remain unverified. Saved agency response: research/MT/access-review-20261027/state-parks.json.
putInAccess.directions: Use the signed Camp Baker public put-in and follow ranger check-in and launch instructions. The marker locates the facility, not the ramp.

takeOutAccess.sourceName: Montana FWP Smith River Recreation Management Plan (2026), p. 19
takeOutAccess.note: The 2026 management plan confirms this public boat access. FWP State Parks GIS geometry supplies a facility location; exact ramp coordinates remain unverified. Saved agency response: research/MT/access-review-20261027/state-parks.json.
takeOutAccess.directions: Use the signed Eden Bridge take-out at the end of the permitted Smith River trip. The marker locates the facility, not the gravel landing.

mapAuditNote: Reviewed 2026-10-27. Both public boat-access facilities confirmed by the 2026 FWP management plan. Approximate facility map available from State Parks GIS; exact landing coordinates still pending.
